title: Harden close bookkeeping commit: typed config refusal, index restore, non-empty failure reason, failure-branch tests
action: Four fixes from review close-lands-bookkeeping-20260810, all in close.rs and its test module. (P2-3) A non-boolean close_commit_bookkeeping value REFUSES the whole close: validate the key up front in close_handler before tests run, emitting a typed error naming the key and the offending value, exit 1, nothing committed — mirror resolve_cleanup_on_merge/worktree_cleanup_on_merge_config (handlers.rs:388-407) where None propagates to a loud refusal; retarget the existing test that pins silent config_off for a string value so it now pins the refusal. (P2-1) When git commit fails after git add -A -- .bee, restore the scoped index best-effort with git reset -- .bee; if the reset itself fails, say so: the warning line and bookkeeping_commit gain the staged-state fact (e.g. reason git_failed:<line>; index_restored: true|false). (P2-2) git_fail_first_line: when stderr and stdout are both empty, fall back to 'exit status <code>' so reason and warning are never empty. (P2-4) New tests: a failing pre-commit hook fixture drives the git_failed branch (assert non-empty reason, warning line rendered with a cause, index clean afterward — proving the reset); a clean-store close asserts reason clean; keep every existing test green. Path-scoped commit discipline unchanged; warn-never-block unchanged for genuine git failures (only the malformed-config case upgrades to a refusal, per the locked synthesis).

truths: a string value for close_commit_bookkeeping refuses close with a typed error before tests run
after a failed bookkeeping commit the index holds no staged .bee entries (or the failure to restore is reported)
reason git_failed:<...> is never the bare prefix

artifacts.substantive: all four fixes plus their tests, no TODO stubs

trace.outcome: typed up-front refusal for non-boolean config; index restored on failed commit with index_restored reported; git_failed reason never bare; failure-branch + clean-reason tests added
